category_title: Students in conflict with authoritarian teachers over classroom rules
minimal_context: The student is entering the ESL class and is instructed to take out a book and a pencil.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Insults the teacher) I'm leaving. (Leaves the classroom without permission)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Take out a book.

STUDENT: (Joking around) Why?

TUTOR: Take out a pencil.

STUDENT: Why?

TUTOR: Please just follow the instructions.

STUDENT: (Insults the teacher) I'm leaving. (Leaves the classroom without permission)
